The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the crisp pleats of the skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Environment: a real famous tourist site photographed at true scale, Rome with the Colosseum, the Roman Forum ruins and terracotta rooftops placed in the foreground at the centre of the frame, rising only to the height of the women's waists and thighs, tourists and tour buses and cars around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; both women are colossal giants standing one on each side of the landmark, slightly behind it, so that the landmark overlaps only their inner legs and clearly shows how much taller than it they are, their towering heels planted on the ancient paved streets, a clear blue sky with soft clouds behind them, the landmark and both women fully in focus, lit by bright natural daylight with soft shadows.
All: Extreme macro detail on the outfits, the skin and the shadows. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a medium distance with the camera at knee height, the famous landmark large in the foreground at the centre of the frame with one woman standing on each side of it slightly behind it, the whole figure of both women from their feet to the top of their heads completely visible, the towering heels clearly separating their shoes from the ground with the real buildings, cars and trees around their ankles shown at their true size so their colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
